species.name: Diving Beetle
mustRead: smooth domed oval shell with a pale yellow rim
silver air bubble held under the wing cases

species.name: Giant Water Bug
mustRead: short piercing beak tucked under the head

species.name: Cave Cricket
mustRead: whip antennae far longer than the body
species.note: Wingless - do not give it the folded wing-covers of a field cricket.

species.name: Moth
mustRead: broad dusty wings held roof-like over the back
species.note: Generic - interpreted as a representative large-bodied nocturnal moth. Antennae are feathered or thread-like, never clubbed like a butterfly's.

species.name: Wasp
species.note: Sleek and shiny - do not draw the fat furry body of a bee.

species.name: Aphid
mustRead: pair of tube-like cornicles on the rear
needle beak stuck into a stem

species.name: Fly
mustRead: huge red compound eyes filling the head
only two clear wings plus knob halteres

species.name: Carrion Beetle
mustRead: flat oval elytra blotched black and orange
abdomen tip left exposed past the short wing-covers

species.name: Cold-Adapted Insect
species.note: Generic - interpreted as a representative polar/alpine insect (snow fly or Antarctic midge type): small, dark, hairy and flightless.

species.name: Stick Insect
mustRead: spindly legs held stretched in line with the body

species.name: Firefly
mustRead: glowing pale yellow-green lantern at the abdomen tip
soft leathery elytra with the head hidden under a shield
species.note: A beetle, not a fly - it has hard wing-covers and only glows from the underside of the rear segments.

species.name: Springtail
mustRead: forked jumping furcula folded under the abdomen
species.note: Not an insect proper - wingless with only six abdominal segments and a spring-loaded tail latch.

species.name: Dobsonfly
mustRead: huge crossed sickle mandibles in the male
long smoky net-veined wings folded well past the abdomen

species.name: Scorpionfly
mustRead: long downward beak-like snout with jaws at the tip
bulbous upcurled scorpion-like tail tip in the male
species.note: The upturned tail is harmless male genitalia, not a sting.

species.name: Thrips
mustRead: narrow strap wings fringed with long hairs
